t: You are standing at the Baroness Burdett Coutts Drinking Fountain in Victoria Park. It is a Grade II star listed structure, which is a high grade for a fountain. It was designed by Henry Darbishire, an architect best known for philanthropic schemes. He worked on projects for Angela Burdett-Coutts, the woman whose name the fountain carries. He was also architect to the Peabody Trust from 1863 until 1885, when Victor Wilkins succeeded him.
